neighbors.interpretation: geometry-only periodic coordination neighborhoods; not chemical bonds
neighbors.motif_validation: reuse a stored orbit motif only when recomputed center element, coordination number, and neighbor element counts all match; otherwise mark the motif unsupported

eligible_polyhedra.geometry: strict three-dimensional convex hull of all unique CrystalNN neighbor sites
validity_conditions: all neighbor sites have distinct periodic identities and Cartesian coordinates
every neighbor is a convex-hull vertex
coordination center is strictly inside every supporting half-space
eligible_polyhedra.unnamed_hulls: Retain other valid CN >= 4 convex coordination hulls with coordination number and existing motif metadata; do not infer a polyhedron name from bcc or cp motif labels.

geometry.facet_merge: merge triangulated Qhull simplices when the same periodic vertex identities lie within tolerance of their supporting plane
geometry.facet_edges: project each merged facet to two dimensions and retain only consecutive convex-polygon boundary vertices as edges
geometry.center_inside: strict negative signed distance from the center to every outward Qhull supporting plane, with the declared tolerance
geometry.overlap_check: corner and edge contacts require a strict separating plane through the shared vertex or edge; edge-plane feasibility is solved by scipy.optimize.linprog
geometry.face_side_check: the common facet identity set must match in both hulls and the two centers must lie on opposite sides of its plane

periodicity.candidate_search: join polyhedra through shared neighbor site-index incidence and derive relative center translations from integer image differences
periodicity.pair_counting: unique undirected pairs of center sites per unit cell; self-orbit translations retain one lexicographic orientation
periodicity.examples: record the relative center image and each shared vertex site index, element, and image

classification.corner: exactly one common periodic hull vertex and a strict separating plane through it
classification.edge: exactly two common periodic vertices, forming a hull edge in both hulls, and a strict separating plane through the edge
classification.face: three or more common periodic vertices equal the same merged hull facet in both hulls, with centers on opposite sides
classification.ambiguous: shared vertices fail the hull edge/facet checks, the hulls overlap beyond a corner or edge, or a common face does not have opposite-side centers
classification.no_contact: no common periodic vertex identity; omitted from sharing counts

record_status.computed: at least one valid convex coordination hull was available; validated zero sharing is distinct from missing data
record_status.not_applicable: no center has CN >= 4 under the frozen neighbor method
record_status.ambiguous: one or more CN >= 4 centers exist but none has a strict valid convex hull
record_status.error: the augmentation pass failed for this row; existing core facts and labels remain intact

output_schema.compact_summary: sharing-type counts, periodic pair count, valid/ambiguous hull counts, motif and element counts, and an English LLM summary
output_schema.connectivity: counts of validated relationships between center symmetry-orbit pairs
output_schema.examples: up to two periodic pair examples per sharing type and orbit pair
